verdict.rationale: The pricing page evidence shows named tiers (e.g., 'Business AI'), per-seat credit allowances (15,000 credits/seat/month), and feature lists (Timeline & Gantt, Time Tracking, Team Capacity Planning, Permissions & Access Control) documented publicly, suggesting a self-serve pricing page exists. However, none of the evidence items show actual dollar figures per seat/tier, so it's unclear the pricing is fully transparent without contacting sales. Missing for 10: explicit per-seat dollar prices for each tier, side-by-side comparison of what's included at each price point, and confirmation no 'contact sales' gate exists for higher tiers.
